**An e-commerce platform organizes product categories using a binary tree structure:**

```
Electronics
├── Computers
│   ├── Laptops
│   └── Desktops
└── Mobile
    ├── Phones
    └── Tablets
```

**Each category node stores its name and links to at most two subcategories. What is the maximum number of categories that can be stored at level 3 (root is level 0)?**
column3: In a binary tree, the maximum number of nodes at level k is 2^k. At level 3, the maximum is 2^3 = 8 nodes.
A binary tree is defined by the constraint that each node can have at most two children (left and right), unlike general trees where nodes can have any number of children.
